read.en: Broadcom fell 4.5% on Oct 16 to $328.75, its third straight decline, closing near the day's low of $328.59. It is below its 5-day ($346.3), 10-day ($356.8), 30-day ($355.0), 100-day ($380.3) and 200-day ($368.2) averages, all falling. MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 15 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($376.1), and RSI is 34.8.
read.zh: 博通 10月16日下跌 4.5%，收于 $328.75，连续第三日下跌，收盘接近当日低点 $328.59。股价位于全部下行的 5 日（$346.3）、10 日（$356.8）、30 日（$355.0）、100 日（$380.3）和 200 日均线（$368.2）下方。MACD 于 10月15日下穿信号线并在零轴之下，抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$376.1），RSI 为 34.8。

read.en: The $343 Oct 1 low and the $335 zone (Sep 16, Oct 15 lows) broke and now cap. Resistance is $334.6–335.8, then $343–346 (Oct 1 low, 5-day average) and $355–357 (10 and 30-day). Support is $321–324 (Dec 17 and Oct 10, 2025 lows), then $314–316 (Jan 23 and Feb 17 lows) and $307–308.5 (March lows). A close below $321 would open $315.
